notice: Open-data candidates for review. Not verified by Third Spaces; hours, access and amenities are unknown. OpenStreetMap records are unreviewed candidates. County assignment uses explicit OSM county tags or a curated city-to-county lookup; it is not a point-in-polygon boundary check. Records without a reliable county match, including records with non-California address-state tags, are grouped under “County Not Assigned — Needs Review.”
